abstract: BACKGROUND: Struma ovarii is the most common monodermal ovarian teratoma and consists mainly of thyroid tissue. Only 5% of patients with this tumor have features of hyperthyroidism. The pathophysiology of hyperthyroidism in struma ovarii is not clear. CASE: We describe a case of benign struma ovarii, presenting with the clinical features of an ovarian cancer: large complex pelvic mass, large amount of ascites and markedly elevated CA-125 serum levels. The patient was initially treated for Graves' disease, on the basis of ultrasonographic, laboratoristic and scintigraphic evidence. The resistance to the medical treatment led to thyroidectomy. After surgery the hyperthyroidism persisted and, suddenly, the patient presented ascites. A large pelvic mass was then diagnosed which, at the pathologic examination, was diagnosed as a struma ovarii. CONCLUSION: The struma ovarii always has to be considered when a pelvic mass is associated with features of hyperthyroidism.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵巣甲状腺腫は最も頻度の高い単一胚葉性卵巣奇形腫であり、主に甲状腺組織からなる。この腫瘍の患者のうち甲状腺機能亢進症の特徴を示すのは5%に過ぎない。甲状腺機能亢進症の病態は明らかではない。症例：卵巣癌の特徴を示す症例を報告する。すなわち、大きな複合性骨盤内腫瘤、多量の腹水、および著明に上昇したCA-125血清値である。超音波、検査所見、シンチグラフィーの所見に基づきGraves病の治療を当初受けた。内科的治療に抵抗性を示したため甲状腺摘出術が行われた。手術後も甲状腺機能亢進症は持続し、突然腹水が出現した。その後、大きな骨盤内腫瘤が診断され、病理検査で卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。結論：骨盤内腫瘤と甲状腺機能亢進症の特徴を併せ持つ場合は、卵巣甲状腺腫を常に考慮すべきである。
